rationale: B is more useful because it clearly recommends a strategy, names a live alternative, explains why validator-first beats broad launch, and gives a practical phased plan with timing, validator counts, and what to ask validators for. It also handles uncertainty better by identifying the main downside of adversarial debate and the opportunity cost of delay. A points in the same direction but is thinner: it lacks a clearly stated alternative, offers little explicit comparison across options, and provides only limited quantitative detail. Neither is perfect on revisit triggers, but B gives the stronger basis for an actual launch decision.
